headline: Get Geoclaw
title: How to Get Geoclaw | Budclaw Evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Budclaw evolves at level twenty one. The easy branch is Shrubclaw. Geoclaw is harder. First you must defeat the Alpha Geoclaw. Then your Budclaw needs the Tenacious personality, and you need a Freeze Stone. Miss the Tenacious personality and you only get the Shrubclaw option. Is your Budclaw Tenacious? Comment below!
description: Budclaw evolves at level 21: Shrubclaw normally, Geoclaw after beating the Alpha Geoclaw with a Tenacious personality and a Freeze Stone.
